name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US struck Qeshm missile site 17 Nov
summary: US aircraft struck an IRGC missile site on Qeshm on 17 Nov; Iran says drones hit US Patriot systems in Kuwait on 18 Nov
state: A US official said US aircraft struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island on 17 Nov in self-defence after Iranian drones targeted a US radar in Bahrain; CENTCOM said the drones were intercepted (ANI via Republic). Iran's army said on 18 Nov its drones hit Patriot systems at Ali Al-Salem air base in Kuwait, and the GCC asked the UN Security Council to act (Gulf News). Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice before travelling to the Gulf; airlines have extended cancellations to some Saudi airports into late November.

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
